layout_sources: https://pypi.org/project/hb-account-statement-banque-postale-csv/ (tests/02.csv, the 2023 export: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, "Numéro de compte", "Type;CCP", "Fichier téléchargé;le ... à ...", "Opérations imputées;du ... au ...", "Solde comptable au ...;... EUR", a blank line, "Date;Libellé;Montant", quoted padded labels, amounts like "-5432,00€"; the parser strips the last character and swaps the comma, so no thousands mark)
https://github.com/binnette/homebank-converter/blob/master/data/tests/banquePostale.csv (the older layout with Solde (EUROS)/(FRANCS) and Montant(EUROS);Montant(FRANCS), newest first)
notes: labanquepostale.fr "Télécharger mes opérations" CSV (2023 layout): five "label;value" lines about the account and the download, a blank line, then "Date;Libellé;Montant". Semicolon, dd/mm/yyyy, the label double-quoted and padded with spaces, the amount signed with a comma decimal, no thousands mark and the euro sign glued to it ("-1095,00€"). UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, newest first. "Solde comptable au 04/11/2026" is the closing: the period of the operations listed runs to that same day. Account number and file name invented.
